hints.title: Identify Index Conflicts
hints.text: Only indices where nums1[i] == nums2[i] must be modified.

hints.title: Majority Frequency Dominance
hints.text: Count the frequency of each conflicting value. If the most frequent value occurs at most half the conflicting times, conflicts can swap among themselves.

hints.title: Borrowing Non-Conflicting Indices
hints.text: If a majority value exceeds half the conflict count, borrow non-conflicting indices that do not contain the majority value, picking smallest indices first.

hints.title: Index Swapping Cost Minimization Implementation

complexity.notes: Two passes over arrays to identify conflicts and resolve majority values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all permutations of index swaps is computationally infeasible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes majority element bottleneck in conflict swapping and borrows non-conflicting indices greedily.
